desc: Ideation: reduce the problem to selecting 2K cakes with an even 3-coloring and choose WQS/Aliens 8-parity DP as the primary approach.
Implement and validate the Aliens/WQS 8-parity DP solution in Python, including fast unrolled DP, encoded lexicographic states, binary search over penalty, and brute-force stress tests.
Confirm sample tests pass and finalize the solution.
